_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: It's a short game but very enjoyable. It would be the best game for kids to play because there is quite a bit of exploring and each new map is very beautiful. I love the art style, it reminds me of my childhood. In terms of worth it or not, its definitely worth playing. Maybe get it on sale since the play time is about 6 hours or less.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: If I use only one word to describe Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, I'd choose "cozy". The game just oozes that magical Moomin atmosphere. Hyper Games has managed to make a moving interactive storybook experience like no other with light puzzles and relaxing gameplay. Definitely recommended for all the Moomin fans out there!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: One of the best Cozy games in all of the cozy game genres. Also you get to destroy everything instead of building something. Most cozy games I've seen have you create or build something, but Snufkin, one of my all-time favorite children's characters, is the most uprooting, chaotic, and nature-loving character to play as, and I think that's a charming change of pace in comparison to other cozy games. If I had played this game as a little kid, I would instantly fell in love with Snufkin. Always find a Snufkin in your life - makes things exciting. Hahaha.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: As a longtime lover of the characters, I was very happy with this game, most of our dearly loved characters made an appearance in some form. The only thing I had a bit of trouble with would be the base controls but that's easily fixed if you want to. It was a short but sweet and heartwarming experience overall.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I have enjoyed peacefulness of this game. Nothing wrong and harm can be done to anyone. Even this game can be played fast, still there is option to enjoy of its slowness. No hurry is needed. Mostly what I have enjoyed in this game is that there is no violence or harm to anyone. It is showing goodness to anyone, and it creates happiness.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This game/experience was awesome!The developers really captured the:- Phylosphical- Comedic- And wholesome part of the moominValley and world overalAs a kid i watched Moomin (the 90's cartoon) but never really understanded any of it.Now fast foward years later i recently got really into Moomin, its characters and the world.I started reading the books and then this game got released, which was a perfect timing.The game is an adventure game set in moominvalley, where you help out other characters and createres.There are great views, fun puzzles and a great soundtrack to boot!The game also has some funny writing, what you can expect from the Moomin characters.This game is quite easy and has a lot of easy but fun achievements to clear.So if your looking at a short and relaxing expierence of about six ours for me, you are in for a treat.I give this game a 9/10 my only fault for the game would be, that the game somethimes bugs a litte, for instance:- Achievements didnt always pop, when i went back to an area it suddenly popped. This way you can mis achievments unfairly.- Instance where i started the a new game the credits form the last game still played (this was fixed by restarting the game.But don't let that keep you from buying this game!It was great fun and i hope more Moomin games will be made in the future.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: What a short fun game, and wholesome experienceSnufkin has a warm place in my heart since childhood (Little My is my favorite)The game is simply a love letter to the world of The Moomins.The game is really peaceful, the characters are lovable, the tunes are nice.The artistry of the paintings really breathes life into the valleyThe gameplay is nice and quite simple.I really liked it!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: At first, I didn't really understand the scene where Snufkin said "It's snuffing time." and then took out his iconic Snufgun and proceeded to snuff out the lives of over a moomillion of our boys in blue. But now that I have stepped away from the game for a moment, I've come to appreciate it for it's subtle anti-establishment message.Snufkin is literally me.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I have very fond memories of watching Moomin as a child so this was one of the quickest purchases of my life. It's a beautiful rendition of Tove Jansson's world and the characters she created. The game is rather short and its puzzles and quests are quite simple but I didn't mind this. Huge props to the development team for the artstyle and soundtrack.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Do you love the Moomins? Be it the original books, comics or the 90s anime series, this is a perfect game for you. The creators of the game have perfectly reflected the wonderful world of the Moomins. The game isn't very long (took me roughly five hours to complete despite going slowly) but it's very good. And it feels wonderful to see all the familiar faces, from both the books and the comics. With beautiful art, great writing and wonderful music, "Melody of Moominvalley" is a perfect labor of love. And though you might shed a tear at the end, it's definitely a feel good game. Plus the Groke gets her (probably) first redemption arc since the books! So chill out, get some warm tea and immerse yourself in Moominvalley, as lovely as you remember it from your childhood.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley is a really cute & beautiful story-oriented  game with some funny dialogue. I played it for around 6 hrs and loved it tbh..It has casual exploring & mini games along with some main & side quests.Very easy and relaxing game (loved the relaxing sceneries in those gazing spots!)
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: One evening of linear gameplay and the game is already played through.. I expected lots more actually.. no freedom in gameplay and no variety in tasks. Sad.. Because the story and character could be so much more. They build a pretty valley, but i can't do much with it besides walking through bushes.. would have enjoyed gardening with moominmama and putting together the rooms in the house with Moominpapa, or going fishing with Moomin. I always loved the storys of Tove Jansson and looked forward to play Snufkin and play through his adventures! But there are no adventures going on unfortunately..
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Fun, cute, relaxing little game. Overall a nice experience, the music, sound design and art style are gorgeous, and the puzzles, even if they are simple, are quite enjoyable as well. It definitely knows how to take advantage of the Moomin nostalgia.Despite this, I have some negatives too. Some parts felt a bit unnecessarily long (woodies I'm looking to you) and some bits felt contradictory. For example, Snufkin says no animals should ever be in cages and at the very next moment he's putting butterflies into jars. At times, it also felt a bit flat and one dimensional. Anyways, I do recommend it if you are looking for something light and chill, specially for kids (7/10).
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: It's just too expensive to justify the total playtime (3-4 hrs). I was super hyped for this game from the art and trailer but I feel like the game itself was just too linear and the mechanics too simple. The entire game is following a very linear path, running through bushes for inspiration and singing to things, some minor fetch quests, and doing some very simple stealth puzzles to undo the parks. The music is also pretty annoying and I ended up muting it because it was so grating, which is a shame because a great OST might have rescued a game like this. I wish the devs had put a disclaimer that this game was tailored towards children, then I would not have felt as disappointed. Either that, or cap the price at $15 usd with a sale price just over $10. That's the price of other games that I think are comparable to Snufkin: MoM.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I absolutely loved this game. It's not too hard, not too simple either. The game reminds me a little bit of Little Misfortune with the playing style. The story is unique and I love the art style of the game. The story itself is very intriguing. If you want to play a cozy game and perhaps finish a game in one day, I would reccomend buying this one. :)

_childDocuments_.review: This game gives me a sense of joy and melancholy. _childDocuments_.review: A wonderful little game, great for family playing. It breathes wholesomeness. If you ever read any of the Moomin books, you will feel as if the pictures from that book somehow came to life. The controls may be a bit clunky sometimes, but it will not distract you from what this game is - a light-hearted love letter to Tove Jansson's world of kindness.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Such a cute game! I love the art and the writing and the music. The story main story was nice, too. I really enjoyed vandalising and fighting back against the ecoterrorism (up yours, Park Keeper!), but I also had a ton of fun completing all the side missions and trying to get all optional things related to achievements. I managed to get all achievements in one single playthrough without having to look anything up, because the game made exploration so enjoyable that I found everything without much effort.It's a relatively short game, considering I managed to 100% it in about four hours, but I don't think that should be considered a negative. I can see myself replaying this many times over, especially because a playthrough isn't super long, so it's easily replayable in an afternoon (or two).
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Moomin franchise deserves more games and better games.This game is fine, but it's certainly nothing special. Little "cozy" adventure with small quests and side objectives. Was completed from start to finish in around 4 hours over 2 days. It's a very small game and if you take the side quests away it's probably an hour or two at best. I wish the adventure of the game was more grandiosque and show more characters with more interactions, and not a single short storyline.Writing seemed pretty on point with the 1990 show, which is good (I never got acquainted with original comics and books, can't compare to them). Game is like a couple of the show's episodes worth of plot. If not one, that is.Music and sounds are pretty, albeit I was very-very dissappointed that not a single leitmotif made it's way from the show into this game. Snufkin harmonica does not play his harmonica songs, no in-game song resembles anything in the show, but it's all pretty good on it's own.Visuals are great, loved the style, loved the cutscenes, loved the vistas. Kinda wish there was more involvement with animations and cutscenes but wanting more of this is probably a good sign.As one of the first official and mainstream releases of Moomins as a gaming medium, it's okay, but I'd love to see more and better.It's a fair and fine game, but better pick it up on sale, it'll be better value for what you get.

_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: The game is really beautiful! So nice and meditative ( / - \ )Let's speak about music first of all. Rarely you can find memorable soundtrack. Each melody made perfectly to build right atmosphere.The art. The way the game depicts Moomin world, characters buildings is simply marvelous. And personally I have nothing to complain about, except the main character- Snufkin himself. It's just my personal view of things. Developers did great work to create this game as we see it now. Bud Snufkin is seems a bit different that Tove painted him herself. Something about his plastic, movement, and timings a little off for me. It's just as I see the character myself. And we mast pay respect to the artists who made Snufkin, he is one of the hardest chars to be painted not by original augther. All in all, gazing spots, artistic way of the game is perfectly done.Plot. Well for me it's a bit controversial. In one way plot is good, really good. But in other it somehow feels a bit rushed... Let me explain. The beginning of the game sets up a nice story. The middle part is well done too! I really liked quest with pirate ship!!! The second problem is how the game depicts a few chars from the book. I fully understand why devs made them this way- no questions. But there is an example- Little My shown here a little toooooo detrimental. On the contrary, Tove explains her as "She was just a glimpse of something determined and independent that had no need to show itself." And I should say- somehow devs managed to show that in some way, but not enough for me. Game version of Snufkin suffers the same problem. But all in all, aside from how I see the world of Moomin, plot is really good!!So to summarize my little review. Aside of all mentioned and that is not written, I really liked this game! It has perfect length (considering the level cap, and minor gameplay issues). One of the greatest visuals (the Sniff's cave has a place that astonished me!!!). And the nice soundtrack that can conquer some AAA games OSTs. I highly recommend this game to all fans of Moomin and those who is not familiar with Tove Jansonn's piece of art!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: As someone who grew up reading The Moomins books and watching the show as a wee child, this game moved me to tears and melted my heart at the tender age of 33. The art is gorgeous, the music is so cosy and magical and the gameplay itself is easy yet quirky and fun, just what you need after a long and upsetting day at work. 10/10 adorable ecoterrorists would recommend.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This game was a true delight to play. Visually, it's absolutely fantastic. They did a good job capturing the art and vibe of Tove Jansson's work. Me being Scandinavian, her work has always been a part of my life and my surrounding. It's very fun to see it still being relevant and given the love it deserves. There's music by Sigur Rós as well, which was an amazing surprise. The overall music and sound design is solid.The gameplay is incredibly easy and simple. You run, you jump, you push, you pick up things, you talk to inhabitants of the valley. The puzzles are without challenge and self-evident to solve. Mostly it's just an item hunt. It might be lackluster for an adult, but perfect for a child. It fits my daughter very well. That's not to say there isn't something here for adults; of course there is. I played it by myself and loved it. It might be more of a walking simulator at that point, but that's fine for what is on display, and for what I wanted; a chill, simple and gorgeous experience in between some of the gory and bloody things I otherwise might play.Snufkin has no darn respect for private property in the Moominvalley. Sheesh. ...but I approve of the sentiment.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I'm a simple man. I see ecoterrorism, I approveJokes aside, this is a really charming game. Reminds me of Child of Light. It looks beautiful, soundtrack is great. Gameplay is a mix of basic puzzles and stealth. Story was really heartwarming. I'm one of the few here who didn't know Moomins before this game, but I still enjoyed my time.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Looking for a cozy, wholesome and chill experience, that is not a farming sim? Well look no further! Not only is this game incredibly stunning visually, it is so cozy and heartwarming in absolutely every aspect. The love that has been put into this game is radiating from every pixel and tune. Absolutely a must play for people that grew up with Tove Janssons work. Play it with the children in your life, or with your inner child. If you love Moomin Valley and the characters within then I'm almost certain you'll adore this game from start to finish. For full transparency I did win a steam code through a giveaway on Instagram. That code was passed on from me to a friend, as I had already purchased a copy of the game just prior to winning the Instagram giveaway. Thanks for the lovely experience Hyper Games <3
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: The most wholesome storybook adventure. As the Moomins prepare for hibernation, Snufkin ventures out on his own until summer. Upon his return, he begins to notice strange happenings while traveling to meet his friend Moomintroll. Strange signs have appeared, creatures of Moominvalley have been displaced, hideous parks have popped up, and the river has since dried up. To make matters worse, when Snufkin returns to their meeting spot, Moomintroll is nowhere to be found. In Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, you’ll help Snufkin restore Moominvalley by pulling out those awful signs, destroying the parks, and disrupting the Park Keeper’s plans - not to mention, finding Moomintroll! I am not a veteran Moomin fan like a lot of those who picked up this game, despite this, I thoroughly enjoyed this game. It’s one of the few where I didn’t mind going out of my way to complete side quests and just explore the area. No quest felt tedious, and Snufkin’s responses were always incredibly down-to-earth because he genuinely cares about every citizen in Moominvalley. Not to mention the relationship between Moomintroll and Snufkin is so incredibly wholesome. The game itself is not difficult, making it a game for everyone of all ages. The game length is also very short, making it the perfect game for a cozy night in. I explored most of the valley and completed most of the side quests (I’m missing some achievements) in about 5.5 hours. If you wanted to run straight through the story, you could probably complete it in about 3 hours. Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley will definitely be one of those games that stick with me for a very long time, and I highly suggest picking this game up for a wholesome musical adventure!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: 20 euros is kind of a lot from a game of this length but I don't mind. I'm glad to support a studio that made this game, because there's a lot of things to like.I like the story, and the way you can point out clear inspirations from original story, but still everything is its own thing. It's very current, and I think Tove Jansson would appreciate the wonderfull anarchism of Snufkin.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Just like a big chunk of the target audience I grew up with the Moomins, books, comics and cartoons alike, and I feel like this game hit just the right cozy nostalgia nerve. I think this might be my favorite ecoterrorism simulator!First of all I can't get over how stunning the visual style of the game is, it's like straight out of Tove's original Moomin illustrations! The sound design is very atmospheric and I really enjoy the simple mechanics of this game. A child could play this and have fun, as for the most part the game is very forgiving. It lets you explore most of the places again in case you missed something and even made the stealth missions fun and light-hearted. Some parts of the stealth and vandalism missions were a bit too easy to just rush through to the next checkpoint.The game comes with multiple language options, increasing the game's replay value for me. The dialogue isn't pushing too hard to be quirky either, it's just as whimsical as it needs to be.A very cozy and simple game that didn't need to be more of anything, but probably would've gotten away with being less than what we got in the end. Warm recommendation!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: For every Moomin fan and non-Moomin fan :D. Super chill and pretty short open-world with a elaborate storyline, added with lots of fun side missions and heartwarming encounters. The artstyle really gives off that cozy childrens' book vibe with watercolor-like backrounds. One thing that bothered me a little was the frame rate, something about the animation felt a bit choppy and flashy? Might also just be my laptop not running the game super good. Highly recommend!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: As a Moomin fan, I LOVE this game. I watched the 1990 TV series as a kid and have dreamed of exploring Moomin valley ever since. I am not aware of any other Moomin video games, but this one is excellent. The classical plots of the original novels are finely adapted to the game, and the watercolor art style, background music, and sound effects are refreshing and relaxing. Besides, the dialogue is definitely BIC and enjoyable lol. In this game, you gonna play as Snufkin which is probably the most popular character from the Moomin series, although he is usually a supporting character.The only shortcoming is that the story is too short! I hope that there will be sequel games in the future. And it would be great if Moomin valley could remain accessible after finishing the main story so that I could continue with minor tasks or just wander around like in an open world.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: All in all, it is a pretty simple, yet fun game. I 100%:ed it in just under 4 hours (also, 100%-ing ties pretty easily in with the games storyline. While it was kind of easy and predictable at times, there were also moments where the games premise changed, and suddenly new and intriguing puzzles appeared. It build off the game mechanic of music, through different instruments and skill levels. Very straight forward, but still offering some freedom of movement and exploration. Discovering new uses for the different abilities was very fun, especially the non-linear ones. Also, moving around Moomin Valley and Hattifnatt island, discovering old characters and talking to them was an experience.I'd give it a 6/10, mostly due to it being kind of short and a bit too easy sometimes. But it is a very beutiful game, and I'd recommend getting it, if you feel like 20 euros is agreeable
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I have been waiting to play the game since ever i tried the demo. experiencing Snufkin's adventure as if they were my own. it made me feel a bit nostalgic. it has been a delightful surprise to see the collaboration with Sigur Rós band. their music is timeless. endless and makes me feel deeply connected to the game. perfectly complement the enchanting world of Moomin. I'm glad they were part in creating such a lovely experience.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley is a game I did not expect to like as much as I did. Exploring the valley, meeting the characters, doing simple quests, and just experiencing the oh so Finnish melancholy of the game were relaxing and the small puzzles and stealth sections presented enough entertainment to keep the game feeling fresh. I feel this was a passion project for the devs, and if so it really shows. There are so many little things, like the water’s reflection shining in a cave, the many vistas and resting areas where Snufkin can sit down and enjoy the view, that make this experience absolutely lovely. While certainly not for everyone, I recommend trying it out to fans of Moomins or anyone looking for a wholesome adventure to take part in!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I really enjoyed this game. This was perfect for it and was a bonus that it was moomins! I completed it on the day I bought it as I couldn't put it down. Really relaxing and satisfying game with a lovely atmosphere. Highly recommend :)
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: My only "issue" with this game is that it wasn't longer. Didn't have any bugs and became just a kid who played lots of Moomin games like Suuri Muumijuhla (Big Moomin Party). Want to become kid again so I'm ready to buy all future Moomin games and story/sidequest dlcs if anything is made (I wish so badly please).The characters were themselves the world was what it really is. This was like those Moomin games I played in early 00s but modern. Perfect 10/10Also huge applause for finnish translation! You nailed it. _childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I've loved the Moomins my whole life, out of any ''franchises'' it has had the biggest impact of my life. It has had an impact that has lasted with me ever since childhood and that is still with me today, as it has defined the way I even view life and taught me values that I hold dearly. So you could say that I have a very clear view of what the Moomins is, and that I have very strong opinions of what makes a ''good'' Moomin adaptation, in my eyes. Ever since the first news that this game was in production a few years back it got me super excited, and you can imagine how painful it was waiting for any news before we got the first trailer to see what this game was going to be like, and that made it even harder to wait to finally play it.Now that I've played through it, do I think it was worth the wait? Yes, but I have some minor complaints. The game looks beautiful, and sounds beautiful. The dialogue is pretty clever, and the characters feels like the characters we all know and love, although it is somewhat simplistic compared to Tove's original work. The melancholic atmosphere works really well, but I am personally more of a fan of the melancholic atmosphere in the books. It's a cozy and relaxing melancholic atmosphere, so I don't complain. The compositional music, although not nearly as memorable as other adaptations, works very well and is very pretty. The music by Sigur Rós is a perfect match for the Moomins, as they are one of the few bands in the world that actually fits a modernized version of Moomin. The CGI series songs are the worst aspect about that show, it is so awful that it ruined the show for me. As a really big fan of Sigur Rós, when it was annouced they were gonna collaborate on the music I got really hyped. Sadly though, the music of Sigur Rós is barely used in the game, it is only used in the beggining and at the end. I had hoped they would use more songs from the Untitled album in more scenes, but... sadly they didn't. It is cool that their music is in the game, but it is used so little that it feels like it was only for marketing reasons that they had them in, instead of actually putting the music from the album to good use. There is only 4 compositions where Sigur Rós has collaborated with the composer, and they are the most memorable tracks, even though they aren't super memorable either.I wish that Moominvalley was bigger, so that we could explore a lot more and also meet more characters, just so we could get more quests and have more dialogue. Just by having more quests with the already existing characters in the game would've been welcoming. The layout of the valley is a little funky, like, the Moominhouse is right beside a cliff, for some odd reason. And also, one big disappointment, you can't explore inside the buildings... You can't go inside the Moominhouse, which is one of the greatest sins in a Moomin game. I mean, there aren't that many buildings we would've been able to to explore in the game anyway, but... come on, it's the Moominhouse, of course I wanna go inside it!!The overall gameplay is pretty simple, which can be a little bit negative for all the epic hardcore gamers out there, but for me the tone and story is more important than the gameplay in a Moomin game, and this game delivers on that pretty well, even if it is a little simplistic. Moomin lends itself best as an open world game, it doesn't need to have complex gameplay mechanics to work well, but I do think the game is a bit ''too simplistic'' than what I expected it to be. I probably sound a bit negative, but I did enjoy my time playing this. I just wanted more. I guess that is the main takeaway, I just want more of it. I didn't wanna stop playing the game, so it definitely captivated me in a really good way. It is easily the best Moomin game we have gotten yet! If we ever get future Moomin games, then this is what we need more of and NOT another point and clickers, I swear to god.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This was a short but VERY sweet experience for me. I loved the Moomin series growing up, and its been very nice to relive this particular story arc, as well as seeing and meeting this game's interpretation of the characters I've grown fond of over the years. Soundtrack and visuals are very charming. Very laid back tone and vibe, I've enjoyed using this game to unwind after a long days work or take my mind off of life's stresses. Perhaps some of the puzzles and missions are a bit too easy, but I don't think that's necessarily a bad thing for a game like this.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This. This game... Wow-This was the most beautiful, heartwarming, and nostalgia endusing journey I have ever experienced in my life when playing a game! - The graphics are STUNNING, really nailed the art style and vibe of Tove Jansson's iconic work. I was just appreciating and awing at all of the tiny intricate details, and the visual style of the game as a whole. It was beautiful, this game could easily belong in an art gallery by itself with all of the scenes. ((The viewing spots where he goes fishing and the ones where he looks up to the starry sky or the sky covered by trees, those were the most BEAUTIFUL additions to the game, I loved seeing them and taking a little break from the gameplay to just appreciate the moment and the whole vibe, just like Snufkin would! <3))- The animated cutscenes, as minimally as they were animated, were very nice and just enhanced all the characters personalities in so many ways, I was enjoying every second of viewing them. <3- I loved seeing Snufkin interacting with all of the different characters as his sassy self, he might fit everything he needs into that little backpack of his, but he certainly can't pack that big personality he has! I loved taking down all the signs and messing with the police. He truly knows how to bring the love and crime to Moominvaley!!! <3 ((I love him so much, he's so me fr fr, I'm so proud to be a Fin rn, kjsadkfjwkeg-))This might not be a game for every adult who's looking for more mature type of content or more serious based stories, but whoever loves the aesthetic, the chill and cozy vibes, the Moomin franchise and legacy as a whole, or just wants a game to relax with and enjoy the moment, this game is for them. We Moomin fans are eating so so good rn, if I hear anybody complaining about it, I won't be listening, your opinion is irrelevant and nobody wants to hear it!  <3
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This game was an easy, slow tempo, fun and atmospheric game. I really loved the music and the places to stop and watch the view. Our 4-year-old daughter got a little emotional and sad over one part (let's just say Moomintroll wasn't in a good place), but I think this might be a fun game to play with the whole family as well as with friends. The puzzles were easily solved, and I think that also made the experience more relaxing. Having played the game through, I wish you could go forward and backward in the gameplay, without having to start a new game, but on the other hand, I don't know if that is possible to do, while keeping the main storyline  in focus.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This game is so wholesome and beautiful. It has an excellent style and soundtrack, and you can really tell it's made out of love for the Moomins. It's immersive and entertaining, and the storyline and dialogue is well-written for each character. It has both relaxing and action packed gameplay, and I'd recommend it to anyone, especially Moomin fans. Lowkey made me emotional. Very well done :)
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This game OOZES appreciation for the source material. There are a ton of references that are spot on and bring back nostalgic memories of the show (90's version in particular). Also, the music and scenery in the game is just beautiful--some of the gazing spots were straight up breathtaking. The gameplay is pretty simplistic, but it does the job and is pretty satisfying.  Probably my biggest complaint is that I desperately wish there were an after-game that gave you some quests based off the comics or the show to give you more content and more interaction with Snufkin and Moomintroll (and Moominmamma, she's one of my favorite characters and I feel like she was barely in this). That would also let you see the restored Moominvalley in all its lush glory.In conclusion: it was pure joy all the way through, though it was maybe a bit short for $30. Although, when the worst thing about your game is that people wanted more of it, you've done a pretty good job. Congrats Hyper Games!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Beautifully charming and endearing, me and my partner have been massive fans of the moomins for years (even using Snufkin and Moomintroll as nicknames) because of how beautiful and charming it is, it cheers us up to no end and this game is the same.The art is gorgeous, every single part looks amazing and would adorn my walls if I could. The music is calming and lovely to hearThe story is soft and lovely to experienceGameplay is basic but it really fits well, I encountered a few moments which were annoying (missing a bee somewhere and then spending ages looking to not find, and being unable to find a butterfly for one of the quests) but they didn't take away any enjoyment, I've been gushing about how lovely the game is for days and I can't see myself stopping anytime soon
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: What a fun, cute game. I enjoy how free it is, you can follow the story however you want for the most part, and there aren't many hints as to where the side missions/characters are or their importance. The soundtrack is nice as well, and the theme of yay nature boo cop is pretty funny. Overall, it borders between the line of a thoughtless and thoughtful game. Definitely recommend. Tips:1. Explore the entirety of Moominvalley before following the main story.2. Mute game when the woodies appear.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: It was a good day to start a journey. Best game ever. I thoroughly enjoyed it, I loved everything about it: the music, the animation, the storyline, the colors... Everything was so well done. I especially loved the little details about destroying the park to restore nature! "Snufkin would prefer a freely growing foliage to fenced in lawns. He prefers to explore the world than to ever settle in one place" And I think this is beautifully encapture in this marvelous game. Thank you for putting all your love into this game and giving us a beautiful journey to experience and remember with joy.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Absolutely magical! A joyful journey into Moomin Valley, the world from books and movies made alive in a whole new way. I've never expected a game so perfect on such an emotional subject, and yet here we are.Visually the game is gorgeous, and it's coupled with amazing soundtrack. The opening sequence for some reason literally made me cry with nostalgia. Must be something to do with intro/ending song, never heard of the band before but now need to learn about them more. Mechanics wise, the game isn't very complicated, so you can simply focus on experiencing the beauty of surroundings and the quest to return old order into the valley. The magic is there, playing felt like returning to the best moments of childhood, meeting old friends exactly the way as I remembered them, and I enjoyed the experience a lot.Be warned, I was stuck for a long while due to a bug with interactable object that suddenly turned non-interactable. You might want to make a copy of your savefile once in a while, just to avoid starting the game from scratch - single saving slot and some rare bugs are the only drawbacks to the whole venture.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: look if your looking at super complex gaming with fancy mechanics that's super in depth or something, this probably isn't the game for you but if your a fan or the Moomin Franchise or casual cosy games with pretty art Melody of Moomin Valley is definitely worth a play! I will warn its a smidge buggy but the developers and support team are super quick and excellent at responding and helping with issues, so fingers crossed that's a non issue further into its release.Anyways I've dabbled in lots of different moomin media from the books to 90s anime to modern show and even a bit of fuzzy felt moomins and this game definitely captures the spirit and vibe of the moomin universe perfectly. The art and the music is beautiful, its a lovely little story with a super soothing vibe (playing this cured my anxiety/j). It also features a range of characters from the franchise which was lovely to see even some I didn't expect too see which was lovely.  I overall loved this experience and may even go back eventually to replay and nab those last 2 achievements I missed and my only wish would be for a dlc with new story so I could have little more time in moomin valley <3
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I’m an American so I didn’t grow up with The Moomins but I know enough about the series and I’ve been reading some of the comics so I decided to get this after  playing the demo months ago. Overall it’s a chill adventure game where you play as Snufkin as he wages battle against the cops and NIMBYs trying to gentrify Moominvalley. Puzzles are rather easy but it’s fun exploring and the stealth segments against the cops add nice variety. The art and music are wonderful, really capturing the whimsical fairy tale vibes the series has. The writing is fun with a good chunk of the game having Snufkin and Little My bouncing off each other. You can tell this is a love letter to the series so fans will definitely get a kick out of it but I think even you don’t know anything about Moomins you’ll still have a fun time, because it’s just a quality game all around.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: It's been 20 years since I actively read or watched something Moomin related. The game was a gift, not only for some playtime but also for a timetravel back to scraped knees and missing teeth. It's been a long time that I felt this mischievious curiosity, and maybe a hint of innocence. As other reviews mentioned, it is not necessary to know anything about the moomins to find an amazing game with a unique artstyle and a nice moral around every second corner. However, when knowing the Moomins there are so many more layers of things that do not have to be explained anymore, the characters, their motivation. They did just so good to do the franchise justice.Either way: if you need to escape the turmoils of the real world a bit, and find joy in a little bit of anti-authoritarian eco-terrorism, this game is for you.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I wouldn't reccomend this game to a moomin fan.While the game is charming, has gorgeous artstyle and nice music, it left me dissapointed.While the main questline is entertaining, the side plots are lackluster, the side plots are just retold stories from the books, but without the depth. Seeing all these returning characters, but without any of the development they went trough in the original story is just...why...It wouldv'e been so much more rewarding if Niny, for example returned as herself and not as 'the invisible girl' it would be a great nod to people who have read the books/watched the shows.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I may not enjoy Snufkin as much as those around me or you, but this game is a great condensed version of everything that Tove Jansson went through and represented over the long years of which she was still with us, which the developers appear to understand; it's more than just a silly little game about removing signs and saving Moominvalley; it represents the aspects of life that was Tove and her ideals / creation. It's her work come to life through the video game medium. If you read the books, you'll be in for a real treat. If this is your first encounter with the names "Snufkin" or "Moominvalley," you will most likely find it uninteresting and more than likely claim it be to nothing but a game meant for babies.

_childDocuments_.review: And they were roommates...On a more serious note, this game perfectly captures the beauty and charm of Moomin. The art style is gorgeous, the dialogue both heartwarming and hilarious, and Snufkin is appropriately sassy and down to commit crimes. Even if you didn't grow up with the Moomin books there's so much to enjoy, and I think this game is particularly well suited for kids to play, maybe even together with a parent. It's not difficult, but requires a little bit of planning ahead at times. Though I must say that I as an adult thoroughly loved the experience as well.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Game looks amazing and has great characters. I looove the 90s moomins but this game is a shell of that series.Atmosphere & artstyle are amazing but gameplay sucks big time. One of the worst gameplay in a game I have seen in a looong time.Also characters are super dummed down. Like "this character is evil", "this character is worrier", "this character is helpful". The 90s moomin series definitely DID NOT do this (for most of the main characters anyway). I loved the complexity and nuances of the 90s moomin series. They talked about tough topics (depression, anxiety, loneliness, ego) but not trying to dumb down everything to a 2 year old's level.EDIT:Also I was excited for "Melody of moomin valley" but it seems to mean the game has a few intruments you can play but as far as I played one instrument ALWAYS sounds the same (and boring). I loved Snufkin's harmonica in the 90s moomin series but I saw none of that awesome music, just some boring harmonica loop. Maybe the game will play some tracks later on (intro song was great). But as for couple of hours nope.For the gameplay what really doesn't work is that the game introduces you to the core mechanics very early on and never really evolves. You use the same gameplay all throughout the game and for 2.5 h I played I never saw any change in how gameplay works. You just go around spamming one button on everything you see. Does it sound fun? Well it's exactly as fun as it sounds.

_childDocuments_.review: Very true to the source material. Beautiful visuals and soundtrack. Gameplay is pretty basic and simple but it doesn't take away from the atmosphere (gameplay makes sense being music themed and all). The game is the perfect length and doesn't outstay it's welcome. _childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: One of the most visually appealing games I have played. The coloring was done very well. Very colorful yet not too visually stressful. I'm not usually a fan of 3D open-world games, but this one gets a pass because its *looks* 2D. Sound design was also amazing!This game is very user-friendly. You only need a keyboard and the controls are very simple. There's a cool musical component where you can press A to play Sunfkin's harmonica to charm animals. I was a huge fan of that. There are also a ton of puzzles throughout the entire game, but they aren't so hard that you're going to have to look up any solutions.Moomin fans will know that in all the various Moomin media, you never get much of Snufkin's first hand perspective. This game definitely changes that. It was cool to see how he reacts with all the secondary characters. If you're a fan of Moomin you will love this game.One thing I don't love is the system for tracking achievement progress. The progress is counted cumulatively across playthroughs, so you can get the steam achievements without actually fully earning them. For example, there is an achievement for . The game is also still a little buggy. I got soft locked and had to restart because . Overall not perfect, but a really fun and relaxing game.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I was expecting a children's game that I would quickly lose interest in, only appreciating the fact that it's based on the Moomins. I'm 37 years old, and I’m happy to have completed this short adventure. Despite its minimalism, the game is very well-made, and it leaves you wanting more. Heck, maybe even someday a bloody action RPG in the world of the Moomins? ;)
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Game was short, the story was left open for hopefully more free DLC. Really loved the music EXCEPT the parts where someone had to include vocals into the song which made it sound like it was about to break into rapmusic which really killed the vibe. WHO WAS THE GENIUS THAT REALLY NEEDED TO INCLUDE VOCALS IN AN INSTRUMENTAL SOUNDTRACK?!If no more content is added, cant recommed you buy it unless you are a hardcore moomin fan.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Although I finished the storyline in approximately 8 hours, I did enjoy every single minute of it. The combination of art design, storyline, music and gameplay allowed me to cozy up at home with Snufkin and the Moomins and escape reality. The pictures are beautiful, the characters cute and like I remember them from my childhood and the music by Sigur Ros provides a sense of calm. The puzzles were entertaining as well. Overall a pretty decent game.. I do hope the developers will come out with some extra content because I feel they could've made this game a little bit bigger.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: So cute and relaxing. I love the art style, it reminds me of childrens' books illustrations. The game itself is an old-school quest with riddles, not too hard, but challenging enough, so you don't get bored. The main problem I can name are the movement mechanics, which are quite clumsy, and sometimes it is very hard to jump on this exact rock or you simply get stuck because it's inconvenient to pass by an obstacle. But generally, the game is awesome for a cozy evening, couldn't recommend more.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This game has truly been a joy to experience. The puzzles are varied and actually fun, it's not constant fetch jobs or things you have to slog through. Beautiful art, music, and characters. It has been such a treat to see Moomin, Snufkin, and friends come to life this way. Buy it full price to support and let them know how much it is loved!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I knew a little bit about the characters going into this but not much and was blown away by this gorgeous game. The music, art, and characters just make this such a charming experience. I played it through once on stream and then replayed it again all cozy on the couch so I could really immerse myself in the story. Highly recommend this beautiful and cozy game.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: As a lifelong fan of Moomins I really appreciated the authentic feel of this creation. The music is wonderful, the art is perfect, the puzzles some are super simple, but no matter- I enjoyed them anyway :D I smiled the whole time I played this. If you're a Moomin fan, this is a must-have in your collection of games.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: An adorable game bringing the spirit of Tove Jansson's beloved and genius children's book series. With beautiful watercolour art, sweet music, well-known and lloved characters and all kind of kooky creatures, the game has an easy and enjoyable mecahnics of doing little tasks of goodness and teaches us the important lessons, like cops are both useless and cruel, nature cannot be owned and private property should be torn down so everyone can roam freely. <3
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Worthwhile buy for me when on sale! A lovely game about belonging, nature, music and friendship. I don't know too much about the Moomin universe, but now I'm curious to learn more about my favorite characters from the game. Gameplay and quests have enough variety to avoid being tedious. Get this game to experience its art, whimsy and storytelling.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: The game sort of presents itself as being more musical than it actually is, which was what suckered me into playing it in the first place. The game is definitely not for me, and it took several attempts to power through. Keeping the review positive though, because there's nothing "bad" about it per say, it just needs to be stated that this game is aimed towards a younger audience despite the property being much older than said audience.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: The game offers an incredible story and an engaging experience that truly immerses you in its world. While there are occasional stutters in the movement mechanics, these minor issues don't overshadow the overall quality of the gameplay. It's a must-play for anyone who appreciates a well-crafted narrative in their games.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: The game is nice and relaxing. If you're looking for a laid-back game, this is it! I'm bad at directions so I got lost several times trying to find my way to where I needed to be. However it didn't take long to finish the game so I was okay replaying it to complete all the achievements. So don't feel rushed playing this game. Take time to enjoy the scenery, the graphic, the music, the character design, etc.! I feel fond of Snufkin, Moomin, and other characters more than ever after finishing the first run.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: As a person who grew up watching Moomin shows (In Estonia), I have to say that this made me so nostalgic. I used to be a huge Moomin fan so this game really was a dream come true. It's very cozy and fun to play. I'm only halfway through while writing this review but you can bet that I'll finish it quickly. (I wish it had my language but I'm used to everyone forgetting about us so it's fine. I enjoy this game just the same). Get it!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Very fun and cute game! Took me 5.5 hours to beat it on my first try, and I did not get every single achievement. The art and sound are amazing, and it's such a heartfelt addition to the moomin family story. The plot of the game is similar to Snufkin's role in Farlig Midsommar, but it is completely different otherwise. I really liked it!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Bought this for my MIL to try play while recovering from an operation as she is a huge lover of Moomins. She has never played computer games but had a go and unfortunately the learning curve was a bit too steep even with the simple controls and calm game pace. However, the game is spectacular visually and the soundscape is absolutely divine, the environment cute, heartfelt, lovely, characters quirky. I have never read the Moomins but I enjoyed myself so much getting familiar with the characters and environment through this game. I feel that the controls and gameplay are simple enough to try for a non-game-player, even though it didn't work out in our case. This game feels like a warm hug from a friend to me (and I bet it's even more so if you already have a warm past with the Moomins), love it <3
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This game is very peaceful to play. I did go through and get all the achievements in the game. If you are the kind of person who enjoys more variety while playing something or want a more challenging game. You might not like this particular game. For me I found it over time kind of boring. Nothing really new or super exciting after a bit of playing. However it is a cute story, with simple game mechanics, and comfortably corky characters. If you want to just relax, explore a large world with weird little creatures, and save the forest this is the game for you.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This is a game all about atmosphere. The artstyle, the sound design and the nostalgia the game presents hit me like a truck and although the gameplay is nothing special or innovative, my experience is still positive. I DO believe that you need to have some relation to Moomin in order for this game to resonate with you. The environment and characters are charming by themselves but require a bit of context in order to fully appreciate their behaviour. I also played the game in my native language (Swedish) due to that all my previous contact with the Moomin-universe has been in Swedish. Sadly, the writing feels very tame, with very little wit compared to how Tove Jansson portrayed the characters in her books.In this game you play as Snufkin, a boy who travels to and from Moominvalley every spring when the moomins come out of hibernation. This season, however, he finds that Moominvalley has changed. The river no longer flows, there are parks and rules put up all over the place and Moomin is nowhere to be found. You control Snufkin as he runs, jumps, interacts with and plays music to the different characters and creatures of Moominvalley. There are simple puzzles, stealth-sections and gathering quests. The game is about four hours long and provides tons of charm along the way.+ Lovely artstyle+ Great sound-design- Repetetive and shallow gameplay- Sub-par writingAll in all, I would recommend this game, but it might be a little too expensive for what you get. I would buy it on a sale, it is a joyful little experience.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: It is the cozy game of the cozy games! If you are such Mummitrolls fan as me, you will love it! I liked that even stressful moments are more challenging than stressful, which is very nice for a relaxing evening! Very happy I got it!If you are a sidequest person, there will be enough for you. However, even with completing all of those I think they game will not take much more than 10 hours total, which is a bit sad. But this is a problem of most cozy games.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I enjoyed the art style and the music for this game. It's charming and using different instruments to play for the various scenarios was intuitive. The art style was very unique looking and charming in its own way. I had some issues with moving the character with a Mouse & Keyboard but luckily enough, I could switch to a controller. I would recommend using a controller if you want to play the game. I did have some issues with the frame rate or the game stuttering when you are trying to move the character to go downwards. It wasn't a huge issue but something to be aware of.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Giving this a positive review because why wouldn't I? It's a very cute game and I love the vistas, and who doesn't want to harass police officers as Snufkin? However, it's a pretty short game, taking me only 4.2hrs to finish it once. I replayed it twice to get all achievements but each time felt like a drag. The map did little to prevent me from getting lost a lot on my first run, and I assume most people only play it once. I also could not figure out how to switch off the tutorial. (BTW there's a Hemulen Painter to the south of the Hemulen Bug Collecter who I missed completely and apparently other people missed him too.)
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I absolutely adored this game. It was a cozy game with a strong message on having respect for nature. The music is great and the visuals are phenomenal. The only issue I personally had was certain mechanics in which you place a boulder down, it's quite hard to get it to sit exactly where you are facing, but other than that, this is a game i'd highly reccommend for anyone who is looking for a cozy RPG with beautiful visuals and music.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I thought nothing would scare me as much as The Groke, but a bunch of rowdy kids were enough to send my heart out into the stratosphere. 10/10Super cute game, and I will probably come back to try and get all the achievements one day. I recommend it to people who like Moomin, the art style, and music. The atmosphere is superb, and all the little tasks are simple enough that you want to complete them all. I would not mind getting more side quests. The play style/puzzles are very simple and suitable for children. Adults might find it a bit too easy if they go in expecting too much. I played the game in Swedish and was delighted with how much the writing reminded me of Tove Jansson. You can really feel the love for Moomin in the writing, themes, and story. I hope the other language options exude just as much of that love.At one point on the map a log completely breaks, which means that you can not make it back to that part of the map without taking the long way around. It makes sense in the story, but since I like checking the map for missed items/action events, and in general just experiencing the beautiful backgrounds and art, it was a shame that it took so much time to get around on that part of the map. (Very understandable though.) When chased it took a little while to get a hang of how to move certain items and what way to move them, which almost made me worry that I had bugged something, but I figured it out after many many tries. All in all a very fun little gem.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Snufkin was a super cute game! The mechanics are very easy to figure out, the puzzles were pretty easy and not frustrating at all. Really liked that we can change the keyboard controls to make it more suitable for personal playing styles. The music was very cute, art style was consistent and not distracting, very pleasing to look at, really enjoyed the overall story. Fun quick little game to play!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I had looked forward to this game since it's announcement, and I can honestly say that the wait was worth it. - Not only have the dev team managed to really bring out the feeling of what moominvalley is like, the characters are also spot on! Wonderful game, short, but non the less a wonderful created game which I'll be playing over and over again
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: It's a good game that can be recommended, although if you're planning on buying this you should note that:- It's a short game- It's not a challenging game- Not much replay value eitherIn short, it's a kids game. But that doesn't mean you couldn't enjoy it. I bought this to get something chill and pretty to play for vacation that's all about the V I B E S, and for that itch it works pretty well. Moomin world works in a video game really nicely, and the game is really beautiful. The art and the music work fantastically. It just makes you wish they'd gone a bit harder on creating a game that would give you a bit of a challenge, at least an optional one. Still, it's really fun to play through, just know what you're getting if buying this.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I adore this game. I was already a fan of Moominvalley from the show so I was nervous that the game might not live up to the humor and animated magic I remembered.I've never been so happy to be wrong.The game was lovely from start to finish!The watercolor-esque graphics are beautiful, the music is soothing, and the dialogue made me giggle more than once.The puzzles are just enough to be challenging without being frustrating or obtuse.And you can't go wrong with ecopolitical anarchy! Restoring nature feels satisfying and brought a smile every time without getting overly repetitive.Would love to be able to play it again for the first time if I could!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I was so hyped for this Game for so long before release and I'm so glad it turned out to be as wonderful as it looked.I grew up in the 90s reading and watching The Moomins and they mean the world to me.This game is so unbelievably beautiful and true to the art and writing of Tove Jansson.I genuinely believe she would be so happy to see this and proud of the team behind it.I highly recommend this game if you love the Moomins as it will genuinely make you so happy and you will love it.The game managed to make me cry happy tears because of how wonderful it is.It would also make a wonderful entry point for someone new to the Moomins.All in all one of the best games I've ever played.You should definitely get it!Thank you to the team!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Ok. Where do I start?I haven't actually played this game myself. However I have watched my ten year old daughter finish the game closely followed by her thirteen year old brother. They both give the game great reviews.One thing we all agree on is that the hand-painted graphics perfectly fit the game and really attribute to the cozy atmosphere you also get from the books. We played through the game first in Swedish and then in English and they were both great experiences.There are some really exciting moments where you need to sneak and play the stealth game which had my daughter on the edge of her seat the whole time. My son really enjoyed trying to find everything and 100% the game during his playthrough. Near the end of the game it takes an interesting turn which my daughter liked very much.The only criticism my kids have is that they thought they were about to finish the game several times and then the game went on. This happened several times during their playthroughs and led to some anticlimactic moments, but in the end they thought the game mechanics and the story were really good. However, they only wanted to play through the game once and they don't see a lot of replayability. The game took them about four hours each to finish.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: It's very much a kids game (for better or worse depending on, y'know, age.): as such, it can be a bit slow, simple and handholdy. But this doesn't really matter when it's got the atmosphere so perfectly right. And it really does.The story feels both like an actual Moomins tale and a whistle stop tour of the characters- in a good way. The art and music are exceptional- especially the art. It's a truly beautiful game, as you can no doubt see. Running around the island, seeing the sights, playing tunes for the creatures that inhabit it, and tearing down the police presence getting in the way of all that; it's all good fun, all so fitting for how a world like this should be explored, and makes for a great Moomins experience.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Very cute game. The art style reminds me of the picture books of my childhood and the soundtrack is nice and relaxing. Snufkin meets up with what feels like every character in moomin valley and it is quite nice to see them all, even if it's just a minor appearance. The game could be summed up as "Snufkin commits vandalism" and that fact alone had me chuckling several times while playing. All in all, an enjoyable 4 hour experience. Worth the money, imo
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Loved the artwork, music, and mechanics. I really appreciated how much the studio paid attention to details and created a story faithful to the Moomin lore. The controls were a little awkward but it wasn't a big problem with custom keybinds. I was taken away by how good the game was at this price point! I highly recommend this game to fellow Moomin fans.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: In Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, you go on a search for your pal Moomintroll and try to bring life back to Moominvalley.The game offers a beautifully drawn and relaxing play through with a good story line and side quests. The game itself isn't too difficult, but there are some missable achievements. If you miss them that's ok because the game has repeat play value.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: A very sweet and fun game to play while talking with friends where it's easy to laugh and joke about all of the funny and sweet situations the developers put you through. Visuals are stunning, music is beautiful, I love Moomin Valley, and I love the way this game understands the characterization of all of our beloved characters!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Very very very sweet and well dedigned game, I enjoyed it very much. Imho I think maybe was a bit too short, wish we could just explore the valley after the final scene and to see the valley resored with all the water. Also, developers, please, please fix all the bugs! There is an issue with the zoom in in the Barometer scene and in thefinal stretch of the final park, where there are a lot of policemen and you need to hid in the bushes at the bottom of the park, the screen moves down and Moomin cant walk fast enough, made me get caught like 10 time, fix it please!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: A great simple fun kind of game. Well enjoyed. The final part of the last mission before you run through the final gates, while you hide in the plant gardens the screen no longer centers on Moomin/Snufkin so u have to blind run as you head to the upper part of the screen. Otherwise no other camera problems experienced in the game with centering on your character
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Very cute and entertaining game. I honestly have a hard time sitting through most games because I lose interest in what's going on, but Snufkin: Melody of Moominvally has an intriguing story that makes you want to see it to the end. Including plenty of quests to keep you busy, and truly gorgeous artwork!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: not too familiar with Moomin other than knowing that it's a thing, but this won me over easily all the same. the visuals, music, and story are all beautiful as hell. it's utterly endearing when it comes to its characters, humor, quest design, exploration, and general mechanics too. sometimes there are moments of minor jank, but this is too delightful to care.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This game is fantastic, it's extremely charming and cool, but at a certain place in the story there is a bug that freezes my screen during a cutscene. This makes it so I can't move and have exit the game to fix it. It resets to a checkpoint before the glitch so I can't progress the story. If anyone has a fix I will change the review but until i hear a solution I can't recommend it
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I SUPER DUPER LOVE THIS GAME. It makes me feel so nostalgic while playing. Many characters known from the books gradually appears and are in their roles with interesting, charming, and lovely motions and stories; I said lots of "awww so cute" every time they were introduced. The graphic is fabulous and aesthetic with very beautiful, calm, and pleasant musics. Also, the voices of every characters are so so cute (again) and fascinated especially Toffle (I have a crush on his naive and child-like voice. Love love love this guy). Hope there will be more updated stories for this game and game development from other stories or even from the books.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: FANTASTIC GAME!! I absolutely LOVE Moomins, grew up with them. I can feel that devs had the same childhood. It is perfect game for moomin-lovers. I saw ideas that devs had during the process about how the Snufkin should look like and what should be the style of the game. I think they made the best choice!!  I am SO happy that this game exists. Also you can stare at the sky through flowers and look at the sea. 10/10
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This game is SO HOLESOME! Enjoyable for/with kids, but also as an adult who loves beautiful handmade art, music and lovable characters. In around 5 hours we tear down parks and zoos, because nature is beautiful as is. In a way, the game says "dont mindlessly listed to authorities and help nature thrive". I love it!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: So beautifully made! I've been playing a lot of games and most of them with far more action than this, but due to depression and other stuff I haven't felt like playing in a long, long time. This was perfect to make me start again. This combines the games we used to play as kids with the nostalgia of characters we grew up with. There's some tricky puzzles but there's no way on Earth you won't figure them out, so you will always feel like you've accomplished something. No one dies, the game autosaves and you just know there's gonna be a happy ending. The perfect game for when you just don't have the energy or mindset for something heavy but still want to solve mysteries and feel all fuzzy inside :)Also: SNUFKIN!!!
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Wonderful game for kids or adults that have nostalgia for the world of Moomin. You have to read a bit, so you might need to help kids who can't read yet.The game is a bit short (I played for 8 hours), and tells a good story. It was really nice to meet so many Moomin characters. I was smiling throughout9/10 (because it could have been longer)I will definitely recommend this game.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: An absolutely stunning little game that very obviously has a lot of love put into it!I finished my playthrough in less than 5 hours and with only 2 missed achievements, so it's absolutely possible to get all achievements in your first blind go.I do miss that there was more of the game, because what I got is wonderful.Metal gear Moominvalley/10, we love an eco-terrorist
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: This game was beyond charming. My knowledge of Moomins was very minimal, I just knew it always intrigued me and drew me in, and I regret that I didn't jump into playing it until this week. Despite it being a relatively short game to 100%, achievements and all, there wasn't a moment I didn't enjoy (though there is a chase scene that had my heart racing, admittedly) and I am officially irrevocably enamored with the world and characters of Moominvalley. You will absolutely find a character (or more) to love (Little My is my soulmate) in the way Snufkin and Moomintroll love one another and you won't be disappointed by the art, music, or charm along the way.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Step into the enchanting world of Moominvalley and reunite with beloved characters in "Snufkin Melody of Moominvalley." This game offers a refreshing dose of nostalgia as you wander through the familiar landscapes and encounter the iconic faces from the Moomin stories. The storyline itself is a delightful and well-crafted tale that will surely bring a smile to your face. The visual aesthetics are simply stunning, adding to the immersive experience.I wholeheartedly recommend this game to both longtime fans of the Moomin stories and newcomers alike. It's a charming journey that captures the essence of the beloved tales, making it a must-play for anyone seeking a delightful adventure.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Spoiler Free review: Honestly when I saw the other reviews on this game I was concerned because the average game-time I was seeing was 2 hours.I've been a huge Moomin fan for several years and this game truly is a great addition to the franchise.Everyone is incredibly true to their characters, the artstyle is very similar to the books, and the overall story and gameplay is a lot of fun and it's a brand new story whilst tying in others into the mix to give it that nostalgic moomin charm.This game almost made me cry when I finished it, It's such a lovely game.If you're a moomin fan or just someone who likes cozy games- I absolutely recommend trying this game out.it's so worth it.(This next part is a spoiler)Also- I find it funny how dirty snufkin is when ruining ms fillyjonk's clothing- one swipe and just so much filfth comes off the guy.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: If you are a fan of Moomin and his friends then you would definitely enjoy this game. It's got a beautiful artstyle, relaxing soundtrack and some nice humor sprinkled throughout the game.And even if you are not familiar with the franchise, you will still end up walking away with a nice and relaxing game you can enjoy for a few hours.Most definitely a strong recommendation from me.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: A cozy game in the theme of Moominvalley (if you have no seen the animated series, I highly recommend it as it provides more background into the returning characters, but is hardly essential to play the game). Overall, I was never stressed, even during the various park stealth sequences and one chase scene. Music was calming and quests were cute.My only regret, one area becomes locked off after returning from it, and by the end I had 2 achievements I felt could have been completed had I simply been allowed to return there. TBH, I was shocked I hadn't naturally completed both achievements just by playing the game, as I felt I was very thorough in every area.Oh, and no matter how much inspiration I collected I could never reach level 8. It insisted on denying me the final sliver of progress, even after collecting tons more inspiration. On the plus side, those players collecting inspiration have solid leeway and can afford to miss bushes/ferns/dandelions/mushrooms/flowers/clams without risk of being locked out of areas or achievements.Overall, despite my minor gripes, a fun game to play.
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: Fantastic game - highly recommend.  Very fun, not very long, and it isn't hard to do all the things.  The only thing I didn't like is the theme song - it's incredibly annoying and sounds very sad for no reason.  Also the credits can't be skipped or sped up and that awful song plays the entire time.  It's basically just one word repeated over and over but I don't know what it is because it isn't in English - I'm not sure if that makes it more annoying or if it'd be more annoying to hear a word I understood over and over - either way, annoying lol
_childDocuments_.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

_childDocuments_.review: I've been a Moomins psycho for several years now and when I found out the game was being made, I was beyond excited. Now that it's finally here and I've played/finished it, I'd like to acknowledge the superb work you've done. First of all, the drawings are extremely beautiful (resembling the cartoon version from the 90s), the universe is faithfully transcribed and wandering around Moominvalley brought me a lot of joy. The watercolor work is also truly amazing! The story is relatively simple but Snufkin as an eco-terrorist is absolutely brilliant, the vibe is immaculate. The musics are nice and even if they’re looped, it doesn't become annoying after a few hours of play. I loved finding and seeing so many characters from the Moomins books/comics; from the Hattifatteners to Ninny, the Muskrat and even the Island Ghost...! The mechanics of the game itself with the instruments and the levels/inspiration to gather are well thought out, my game went as smooth as possible with absolutely no bugs. The huge plus for me would be for The Groke, a terribly underrated character (but one of the best in my opinion and in the entire Moomins universe)! The little detail of “she” made me very happy. She also has a place of honor in this game and I really appreciated it. I enjoyed following the progress of the game's development and I loved playing it, I highly recommend it to all “cozy gamers” and even more to all the fans of The Moomins universe and of Tove Jansson‘s work! A huge thank you and congratulations to the entire Hyper Games team, you have done an excellent job and paid a very faithful homage to the original works!
